## Problem

`public/llms/comparisons/tomas-haake-vs-blake-richardson.md` has two errors on Blake Richardson's side. Tomas Haake's side and all other facts in the file are verified-correct.

## Verified ground truth

`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js:2477,2481`, `packages/frontend/data/cymbalSetups.js:382-394`, `packages/frontend/data/extendedBios.js:7335,7338,7371,7373`, `packages/frontend/data/drummerEvolution.js:6703`:

- Cymbals (current, since 2018): **Sabian** (HHX Evolution Hi-Hats, HHX Evolution Crash, AAX Holy Chinas, HH Raw Bell Dry Ride, HH Duo Splash, Radia Cup Chime) — "Meinl Byzance Series" was his earlier 2006-~2017 endorsement, since superseded; not current
- Bass drum hardware: **twin Tama Iron Cobra Power Glide single pedals** (not a linked double pedal) — not "Pearl Demon Drive double pedal," which belongs to a different drummer's endorsement block entirely

## Fix

File: `/home/runner/work/MetalDrummerGear/MetalDrummerGear/public/llms/comparisons/tomas-haake-vs-blake-richardson.md`

Line 25, replace Blake Richardson's half:
`"Blake Richardson uses Meinl Byzance Series cymbals (Dark, Extra Dry, and Traditional models) — darker and musically complex, providing the tonal depth and harmonic richness that BTBAM's diverse compositional demands require."`
with:
`"Blake Richardson uses Sabian cymbals (HHX Evolution Hi-Hats, HHX Evolution Crash, AAX Holy Chinas, HH Raw Bell Dry Ride) — bright and articulate, providing the tonal clarity and harmonic richness that BTBAM's diverse compositional demands require."`

Line 28, replace Blake Richardson's half:
`"Blake Richardson uses a Pearl Demon Drive double pedal, a conventional direct-drive setup optimized for the responsive, fluid double bass work BTBAM's diverse compositions require."`
with:
`"Blake Richardson uses twin Tama Iron Cobra Power Glide single pedals (not a linked double pedal), giving him independent foot control for BTBAM's diverse compositions."`

Leave Tomas Haake's text on both lines unchanged (already verified-correct against `cymbalSetups.js:105-113`).

## Verify

1. `grep -n "Meinl Byzance\|Pearl Demon Drive" public/llms/comparisons/tomas-haake-vs-blake-richardson.md` returns nothing
2. `grep -n "Sabian cymbals (HHX Evolution\|twin Tama Iron Cobra Power Glide single pedals" public/llms/comparisons/tomas-haake-vs-blake-richardson.md` returns the corrected lines
3. Tomas Haake's text on both lines unchanged

## Done

Blake Richardson's cymbal and pedal claims match `endorsementNews.js:2477,2481` / `cymbalSetups.js:382-394` / `extendedBios.js:7335-7373`.
title: SEO: public/llms/comparisons/tomas-haake-vs-blake-richardson.md fabricates Blake Richardson's cymbals + pedal (outdated/wrong brand)
